I haven't seen Happy Death Day.

As for recent DVD releases, I have a few suggestions you might be able to find.....

The Devil's Candy was a decent slow burn psychological horror, though again it's light on the gore and violence aspect.

It Comes At Night was similarly a slow burn though much slower, but also more atmospheric, you'd like it if you liked The VVitch or Blair Witch (though it's not found footage).

The Belko Experiment was the opposite of the above, replete with a ridiculous amount of violence and gore with some humor sprinkled in, it was great, think Battle Royale but in an office building.

LIFE was a good space creature feature, albeit a tiny creature, it was a decent mix of sci-fi, gore and intensity, like a miniscule version of Alien.

The Void was like a mix of Hellraiser and Halloween, without the iconic depth of character of either, still... it has a healthy amount of Cthulu mythos and gore, so it was a decent B flick.

On the off chance you get the chance to stream something on Netflix, Check out The Babysitter or The Ritual, neither are amazing, but they're both solid in different ways.

Hope that helps.
